## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Restore `--wait` before merge because existing scripts that use it fail during the documented transition release.

## Changes

The pull request renames `--wait` to `--timeout` in the argument parser and its tests. It adds a transition decision and retains the 30-second default and JSON and CSV formats.

## Critical

- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Restore `--wait` as a deprecated alias — `--wait 12` exits with status 2. The parser registers only `--timeout`, while `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` says to “Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used.” — Existing scripts using `--wait` stop before their command runs during the release that promises compatibility. — Fix: Have the deprecated alias populate `args.timeout`, emit a warning only when `--wait` is used, and extend `test_explicit_options`.
